resources.string: Repeated calls with identical arguments pause at the limit. Unlimited automatic execution asks for confirmation after a reset.
Compaction folds earlier tool results and summarizes history, retaining the latest %1$d turns. The full record stays in the session.
Configure SSH and mounts independently. Paste commands into Termux; Agent commands follow session approval. Diagnostics check permission and results.
Allow the permission to run commands in Termux. If no prompt appears, find it under app details → Permissions → Other permissions. Status refreshes on return.
Run commands in Termux. whoami prints the username; run passwd for password login. sshd listens locally. Verify its fingerprint before the first connection.
Add 127.0.0.1:8022 with the username from whoami and password or key authentication.
Grant a folder in the picker (Termux is in the sidebar), without all-files access; use /mnt/alias. Disable read-only to allow writes. Rename conflicting aliases.
Always includes %1$s; keys are optional and avatars stay here. Encryption works for local and WebDAV backups and is required with keys.
Data stays on this device; WebDAV provides manual backup and restore. Password encryption is optional unless keys are included.
Enable the engine to run imported GGUF models on this device for privacy and low latency.
Matching tasks load SKILL.md instructions and references. Skill packs themselves do not execute code.
